intent: Create natural water-plant colonies with asymmetric overlap, shoreline contact, and authored open-water corridors instead of sparse patterned scatter.
required_inputs: optional duckweed or micro-accent mesh set
responsibilities: build irregular colony centers and lobe scales
assemble a dense overlapping leaf underlayer
add low-frequency flower accents on a separate branch
add anisotropic micro accents on a separate branch
preserve deliberate macro gaps and open-water corridors
validate both shoreline contacts and the waterline

output_contract.waterline: hide stems and bases while retaining readable leaf silhouettes

hard_failures: uniform grid or evenly spaced ring
colony pattern that ignores the shoreline
loss of the authored open-water corridor
one tiled patch repeated around the water body
promotion_evidence: left and right shoreline contact views
independent visual scores of at least 4/5 with no hard failure
